questions.stem: 要保護珊瑚礁（coral reefs）並不容易，因為現在珊瑚白化（coral bleaching）發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍。
questions.answer: It is not easy to protect coral reefs, because nowadays coral bleaching happens five times as frequently as it did decades ago.
accepted_answers: It is difficult to protect coral reefs, since coral bleaching now occurs five times more often than it did several decades ago.
It is hard to protect coral reefs, because coral bleaching now takes place five times as often as it did a few decades ago.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要保護珊瑚礁並不容易）
倍數比較（發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍）

questions.stem: 許多珊瑚礁（coral reefs）已因為海水變暖而嚴重受損，使原本住在那裡的魚類失去棲息地。
questions.answer: Many coral reefs have been severely damaged by warming oceans, causing the fish that once lived there to lose their habitats.
accepted_answers: Because the sea has become warmer, many coral reefs have been seriously damaged, leaving the fish that used to live there without homes.
Many coral reefs have already been badly harmed by warmer seas, making the fish that once lived there lose their habitats.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使…失去棲息地）
完成式被動（已經…嚴重受損）

1.explanation_zh: 「要保護珊瑚礁並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to protect coral reefs。後半句的「發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍」是倍數比較，英文把「次數」化成頻率：nowadays coral bleaching happens five times as frequently as it did decades ago（或 five times more often than …）；「現在」可寫 nowadays／now；比較對象用 it did（代替 happened）＋ decades ago。
evidence: 要保護珊瑚礁（coral reefs）並不容易
發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍
1.strategy_zh: 倍數放在比較結構前面：five times + as frequently as／more often than；比較的兩邊要對稱（nowadays … happens ↔ it did decades ago）。
hints: 切成四段：要保護珊瑚礁並不容易／珊瑚白化發生的次數／幾十年前／的五倍
標的詞彙：protect（保護）、happen（發生）、frequently（頻繁地）、decade（十年）
句型框架：It is not easy to VR …, because S + V + five times as frequently as + S + did + 時間

2.explanation_zh: 「已…嚴重受損」用完成式被動 have been severely damaged；原因「海水變暖」可名詞化成 by warming oceans，也可以寫成子句 because the sea has become warmer。「使…失去棲息地」是結果，用句尾分詞 causing the fish … to lose their habitats（cause + O + to VR；habitat 也可寫 home）。「原本住在那裡的魚類」用關係子句 the fish that once lived there。
evidence: 已因為海水變暖而嚴重受損
使原本住在那裡的魚類失去棲息地
2.strategy_zh: 主幹 Many coral reefs have been damaged；原因用 by + 名詞片語；結果用 , causing + O + to VR，O 後面再接 that 子句。
hints: 切成四段：因為海水變暖／而嚴重受損／使原本住在那裡的魚類／失去棲息地
標的詞彙：damage（損害）、warm（溫暖、變暖）、fish（魚）、habitat（棲息地）
句型框架：S + have been + adv. + p.p. + by N, causing + O + that … + to VR …

references: It is not easy to protect coral reefs, because nowadays coral bleaching happens five times as frequently as it did decades ago.
It is difficult to protect coral reefs, since coral bleaching now occurs five times more often than it did several decades ago.
It is hard to protect coral reefs, because coral bleaching now takes place five times as often as it did a few decades ago.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要保護珊瑚礁並不容易）
patterns.frame: It is not + adj. + to VR …

patterns.label_zh: 倍數比較（發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍）
patterns.frame: S + V + five times as often as … / five times more often than …

parts.zh: 要保護珊瑚礁（coral reefs）並不容易
accepted: It is not easy to protect coral reefs
It is difficult to protect coral reefs
It is hard to protect coral reefs
It is not easy to save coral reefs
Protecting coral reefs is not easy

common_errors.wrong: Protect coral reefs is not easy
common_errors.right: It is not easy to protect coral reefs
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語不能直接當主詞；用虛主詞 It is not easy to VR（或 Protecting … is not easy）。

common_errors.wrong: It is not easy for protecting coral reefs
common_errors.right: It is not easy to protect coral reefs
common_errors.explanation_zh: It is + adj. 後面接 to + 原形動詞。

parts.zh: 珊瑚白化（coral bleaching）發生的次數

common_errors.wrong: the times of coral bleaching happening
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「發生的次數是…的五倍」不必把「次數」譯成 times 當主詞；直接用動詞 happen 加上 five times as often as。
happen 是不及物動詞，沒有被動。

accepted: it did a few decades ago

common_errors.explanation_zh: 代替前面的一般動詞 happens 要用助動詞 did，不用 was。
「幾十年」是 decades，不說 several ten years。
倍數比較要有比較級或 as … as：five times as frequently as／five times more often than。

traps.literal_error: because the times of coral bleaching happening is five times of decades ago
traps.explanation_zh: 「次數」是抽象名詞；英文較自然的說法是把它化成頻率副詞，用 happen … five times as often as …；硬譯成 the times of … 會寫出不合文法的句子。

traps.zh: 要保護珊瑚礁（coral reefs）並不容易
traps.literal_error: Protect coral reefs is not easy, because …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿「保護珊瑚礁」這個動作當主詞；英文用虛主詞 It is not easy to VR，或改成動名詞 Protecting …。

1.restructuring_zh: 「要保護…並不容易」改用虛主詞 It is not easy to …；「發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍」不把「次數」當主詞，改寫成 happens five times as frequently as it did decades ago。

references: Many coral reefs have been severely damaged by warming oceans, causing the fish that once lived there to lose their habitats.
Because the sea has become warmer, many coral reefs have been seriously damaged, leaving the fish that used to live there without homes.
Many coral reefs have already been badly harmed by warmer seas, making the fish that once lived there lose their habitats.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使…失去棲息地）
patterns.zh_trigger: 使原本住在那裡的魚類失去棲息地

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（已經…嚴重受損）
patterns.frame: S + have been + adv. + p.p. + by …
patterns.zh_trigger: 已因為海水變暖而嚴重受損

accepted: Because the sea has become warmer
because the oceans have become warmer

common_errors.right: because the sea has become warmer
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「海水變暖」是持續的變化，用現在完成式或比較級 warmer；也可以名詞化成 warming oceans。
by 後面要接名詞片語；warm 是形容詞，改成 warming oceans 或 warmer seas。
珊瑚礁是「受損」，要用被動 have been damaged。
修飾過去分詞用副詞 seriously。

parts.zh: 使原本住在那裡的魚類
accepted: causing the fish that once lived there
leaving the fish that used to live there
making the fish that once lived there
causing the fish that used to live there
forcing the fish that once lived there

common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後表結果用分詞 making／causing，不能再加一個主要動詞。

common_errors.wrong: causing the originally living there fish
common_errors.right: causing the fish that once lived there
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「原本住在那裡的」要放在 fish 後面，用關係子句。
cause + 受詞 + to + 原形動詞。
「棲息地」是 habitat（也可說 home）；living place 不是自然的英文說法。

traps.literal_error: Many coral reefs have been badly damaged because sea water become warm.
traps.explanation_zh: 「海水變暖」是一個持續的變化，英文可名詞化成 warming oceans／warmer seas 放在 by 後面，或寫成完整子句 because the sea has become warmer；直譯 sea water become warm 少了時態與冠詞。

traps.literal_error: causing the originally living there fish to lose their homes
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把「原本住在那裡的」放在「魚類」前面；英文要用關係子句 the fish that once lived there 放在名詞後面。

bonus.text: Many coral reefs have been severely damaged by warming oceans, leaving the fish that once depended on them with nowhere to live.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 leave sb with nowhere to live（使…無處可住）加強語氣，depend on them 點出魚類和珊瑚礁的依存關係。

2.restructuring_zh: 「因為海水變暖而嚴重受損」可以把原因名詞化成 by warming oceans 放在被動句的 by 後面；「使原本住在那裡的魚類…」用句尾分詞 causing … 表結果，並把「原本住在那裡的」改成關係子句放到 fish 後面。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.2.patterns[1]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: It is not easy to protect coral reefs, because coral bleaching now happens five times as often as it did a few decades ago.
1.explanation_zh: 「要…並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to…；「發生的次數是…的五倍」用倍數＋as often as；比較對象是幾十年前的情況，用 it did a few decades ago 補足。

2.translation: Many coral reefs have been seriously damaged because of warming oceans, causing the fish that used to live there to lose their habitats.
2.explanation_zh: 「已…嚴重受損」用現在完成被動；「因為海水變暖」用 because of warming oceans（也可 because the ocean has become warmer）；「使…失去棲息地」是結果，用句尾分詞 causing … to lose；「原本住在那裡的魚類」用 that used to live there 關係子句。

1.translation: It is not easy to protect coral reefs, because coral bleaching now happens five times as often as it did several decades ago.
1.explanation_zh: 「要保護珊瑚礁並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to …；「發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍」用倍數比較 five times as often as it did …，比直接講『次數』更自然。

2.translation: Many coral reefs have been seriously damaged by warming seawater, leaving the fish that used to live there without a habitat.
2.explanation_zh: 「已因為海水變暖而嚴重受損」用現在完成式被動 have been seriously damaged by；「使原本住在那裡的魚類失去棲息地」用現在分詞 leaving … without a habitat 表結果，used to live 對應『原本住在』。

issues_zh: 「發生的次數是幾十年前的五倍」很容易直譯成名詞式倍數比較 the number of times coral bleaching occurs is five times that of several decades ago；第 2、3、4 部分的 accepted 只收副詞式 five times as often as，名詞式寫法在三個部分都對不上，切法對這種合文法的寫法不公平。建議補上名詞式的 accepted。
